text:
Self-Evolved Reward Learning (SER) proposes an approach to training reward models in Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) that reduces reliance on extensive human-annotated data [2411.00418].

Key aspects of the proposal include:
*   **Self-Generation of Training Data:** Instead of relying solely on human or external AI feedback, the reward model (RM) is designed to generate its own additional training data.
*   **Iterative Improvement:** The reward model uses this self-generated data to iteratively improve itself.
*   **Reduced Human Dependency:** The method aims to enhance RM performance even when the amount of human-annotated data is limited, mitigating costs and potential human biases [2411.00418].
